name: WWII Infantry
bio: Dug in since '44. Nobody told him the war ended, and he is not taking chances.
notes: Drive, 2026-11-01 evening, fourth drop ("WWII Infantry Soldier", rigged); rebuilt 2026-11-02 from the owner's updated download ("Meshy_AI_WWII_Infantry_Soldier_All_Animations-3.glb", Drive id 1-aQAgjpSXNcO3XmZjkjNL7S4SxrsMFze), which adds clips of walking forward and back while shooting. A rigged Meshy download ("All Animations": Mixamo joint names, read as Meshy's; its finger joints are not used: the hands are fitted by hands.mjs). Its Walking clip is in the shared clip set every look moves with (content/clip-sets/shooter.json); it had a set of its own (meshy_wwiisoldier_clips, 2026-11-02) until the shared set, which adds a running-while-shooting upper body his download lacks, replaced it. CC0 (Meshy community; confirmed by the owner 2026-11-01). Name a placeholder. Rebuilt 2026-11-05 (intake step 2b) from the re-rigged download "WWII Infantry Soldier in Olive Uniform" (Meshy rig, Mixamo skeleton; its clips not used).
